title: The Polar bear on the ice
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：polar　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 polar 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the builder wrote of ① a polar bear on the ice in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② so polar that nobody in the site would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the polar ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the polar bear on the ice that anybody there had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1986 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too polar to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the polar ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a polar difference between the two views, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as polar as the difference between the two views they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was polar or not, and he said so.

By 1999 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something polar, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite polar; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the polar ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2002, in public, she wrote of another polar bear on the ice in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less polar than anybody had expected. ⑩ The polar difference between the two views that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2004, was the one she could never quite name; the polar ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 极地（前置定语 a polar bear on the ice：1992 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件极地的北极熊）
B. adj. 极地／截然相反（两处加强说法：so polar that … 与 no less polar than …）
C. adj. 极地／截然相反（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 极地（表语 too polar to do：母亲觉得它太极地，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 截然相反（前置定语 a polar difference between the two views：叔叔把整件事称作一桩截然相反的截然对立）
F. adj. 截然相反（同级比较 as polar as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩两种观点之间的截然对立相比）
G. adj. 截然相反（后置定语 something polar：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 截然相反（受程度副词修饰 quite polar：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: a polar bear on the ice
the polar bear on the ice that
a polar difference between the two views
The polar difference between the two views that

answers.why: polar 意为“极地”，1992 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件极地的北极熊”，此处作前置定语 a polar bear on the ice。
polar 意为“极地”，此处用 so polar that 结构，说它极地到工地里没人敢靠近。
polar 意为“极地”，施工图上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的极地冰上的北极熊，等于最高级的说法。
polar 意为“极地”，母亲认为这件东西“太极地了，谁也用不上”，too polar to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
polar 意为“截然相反”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩截然相反的截然对立”，此处作前置定语 a polar difference between the two views。
polar 意为“截然相反”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩两种观点之间的截然对立一样截然相反”，同级比较用 as polar as。
polar 意为“截然相反”，施工图上那半行字要的是“截然相反的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something polar。
polar 意为“截然相反”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当截然相反”，quite 修饰原级 polar。
polar 意为“截然相反”，no less polar than 表示“其截然相反不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之截然相反不亚于任何人的预料。
polar 意为“截然相反”，母亲 2004 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的截然相反截然对立”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1992 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件极地的北极熊。（a polar bear on the ice）
它极地到工地里没有一个人敢靠近。（so polar that …）
母亲觉得它太极地，谁也用不上。（too polar to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩截然相反的截然对立。（a polar difference between the two views）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩两种观点之间的截然对立一样截然相反。（as polar as …）
到了 1999 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件截然相反的东西。（something polar）
answers: In 1992 the builder wrote of a polar bear on the ice in the plan.
It was so polar that nobody in the site would go near it.
My mother thought it too polar to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a polar difference between the two views.
He said nobody would call it as polar as the difference between the two views they had once had.
By 1999 the plan asked for nothing but something polar.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 polar 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1992 the builder wrote of a polar bear on the ice in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the polar bear on the ice that anybody there had ever seen, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too polar to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a polar difference between the two views, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite polar, and everybody laughed.
The polar ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
